@firstsquawk, citing The Wall Street Journal: Oil retreats amid US-Iran diplomatic push
Why it matters: If the reported effort delivers a durable reduction in tensions, it could ease concern about future oil-supply disruption. Evidence of changes in production or exports would still be needed before treating it as physical supply relief.
Context: Reuters' 21 October oil-market report described an absence of US-Iran dialogue. The later relay could refer to an effort to bring the sides together rather than talks already under way; the two reports do not establish a continuing negotiation or a diplomatic breakthrough.
